description: Build a real, unsigned buyer-started deal on Arbitrum One: a USDC approve and a proposeDeal transaction for the buyer's wallet to sign. Use only when the user wants a real deal; to just try the flow, use sandbox_create_deal. Nothing is signed or sent. Refuses when funding is paused or closed.

acceptance_window.description: Seconds the seller has to accept. 600 to 2592000.

arbitration_window.description: Seconds for arbitration. Buyer Review at least 604800.

buyer.description: Checksummed buyer address. This wallet would sign. The tool does not sign.

decision_window.description: Seconds the buyer has to decide. Automatic at least 86400, Buyer Review at least 172800.

delivery_window.description: Seconds the seller has to deliver. 600 to 2592000.

fallback_seller_bps.description: Seller share if the deal falls back, in basis points. 5000 = 50%. Automatic needs at least 5000.

manifest.description: Agreed deal text. It is hashed locally and is not stored by this tool.

salt.description: Optional 0x-prefixed 32-byte salt. A random salt is used when omitted.

seller.description: Checksummed seller address, different from the buyer.

name: prepare_deal
title: Prepare an unsigned buyer-started deal
